title: Kissed Brazilian Tempeh Stir-Fry
description: A yeasty, silky, lazy Sunday dish that blends tempeh with redcurrants for a tangy, emulsified flavor, all cooked in a wok.
instructions: Press and cube tempeh, then pat dry.
In a small bowl whisk soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, and water until integrated.
Heat wok over medium-high and add sesame oil, swirling to coat.
Add tempeh cubes and stir-fry until golden, about 5 minutes.
Push tempeh to side, add minced garlic and ginger, sauté until fragrant, 30 sec.
Pour the sauce mixture into wok, reduce heat to medium, letting it thicken slightly.
Toss in redcurrants, letting them mingle with the sauce for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and chopped green onion for garnish, stir briefly.
Remove from heat, let sit 1 minute for flavors to meld.
Serve hot over steamed rice or quinoa.
